description: Boulder County Democrats Chair Ben Cowan kindly invites you to a fundraiser in support of State Senator Janice Marchman. Janice is committed to being an independent voice at the Capitol, fighting to lower costs, strengthen public education, protect workers, and defend Coloradans’ right to privacy.
